Armed with the ambition, necessity and idealism of youth, Charlize, Kheng, and Sani enter the Prison Service with very different goals. Best Telenovela - National Winner Asian Academy Creative Awards (2020) | Kin is a drama about the complexities of life, love and family relationships. Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after having been swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. Ella has accepted her fate as a member of the salt of the earth, working-class Loh family but struggles to make something of her life. Has the nature vs nurture battle run its course or are relationships between the families still as fraught and complicated as ever? The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

By Your Side follows families caring for loved ones with rare diseases, special needs, disabilities and the challenges of ageing. Parents of children with West syndrome and Harlequin ichthyosis navigate seizures, intensive treatments and daily care while celebrating every small achievement. Mothers of adult sons with ADHD, autism and intellectual disabilities devote years to helping them gain confidence, skills and independence. The series also follows families facing ALS and dementia, where spouses and children provide constant care as their loved ones gradually lose their independence. Across generations, these caregivers sacrifice careers, time and personal freedom, yet find strength in love and companionship. Their stories celebrate resilience, acceptance and the preciousness of simply being by someone's side.

They trusted her. Then, a series of mysterious deaths raised a chilling question: what, if anything, connected them? At the centre of the case is Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, widely known as “Aem Cyanide”, whom police came to suspect in a number of deaths across Thailand. What began as an investigation into individual cases soon widened as police uncovered possible connections between them. Cyanide became a key focus, while questions emerged over money and the ‘sharing circle’ relationships which Aem had with some who died. With rare access to those closest to the case, the series goes inside an investigation that gripped Thailand and left families searching for answers. As new details come to light, it traces how suspicion fell on Aem and examines the evidence that turned a series of mysterious deaths into one of Thailand’s most extraordinary criminal investigations.

Kisah Tok Kadi (Tok Kadi's Story) This is a light hearted drama series that revolves around the life of a young popular 'tok kadi' Shahrul who successfully conducts solemnization for couples each week. In each episode Kisah Tok Kadi shows some of the unique experiences that he faces during solemization and how he tackles those challenges. What makes the Tok Kadi loveable is his 'khutbah nikah' (wedding sermon), which is witty and funny without being too religious.

Walaupun menghadapi konflik sesama sendiri, mereka berperang dengan konflik dalam diri mereka dan bagaimana mereka mengatasi kelemahan mereka.

p.t: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
p.d: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

Gummy lives in an apartment with his friend Harry the Chameleon, while his other friend Kala the Cat hangs out in a ninja dojo on the roof. Together they go on wild and wacky adventures in their building and hometown. Enjoy the fun and crazy adventures!

Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.
Great Projects From Ordinary Cardboard!

The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

13-year-old Peru is an only child who lives with his mother and grandmother. With his father is seldom in the picture due to his work overseas, a hardworking mother and a kooky grandmother, an awkward comic-loving Peru is left to his own devices as her navigates growing up in a quaint Singapore neighbourhood. One fateful day, through sheer coincidence, Peru finds himself in the living room of the three men-children who for some reason have no problem letting this young kid hang out with them. Arun - the food reviewer, Vijay – the job-hopper and Jagdish – the illustrator make up the menagerie of Peru’s new group of friends. Part immaturity, part aloofness of the three men makes Peru feel like an equal and he begins to open up to them. Peru comes to the house with his growing pain of the week. It’s unusual if the three bachelors actually offer any solutions, but Peru definitely inspires the three men to reflect on their lack of maturity and together the four of them grow up together. The four of them embark on a meaningful journey of friendship that will change their lives forever.
